verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native way to start Grok Build tasks from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack, such as an @mention bot, issue or PR trigger, or Slack app. Headless mode (-p) and ACP are generic building blocks you could script your own bots with, which would require substantial custom glue. The Linear MCP example only lets the agent call Linear tools; it does not let Linear start the agent.
